subject: POC outcomes — efficiency gains & quick endorsement?
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@standupai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC outcomes — efficiency gains & quick endorsement?

Hi Alyssa —

Congrats again on wrapping the two-week POC with your engineering team. Attached is a short one-page snapshot of the metrics we tracked during the run (standup_poc_kpi_snapshot.pdf) plus the demo recording from 2026-09-24. Quick highlights: 

- End-to-end inference latency reduced by ~42% for your average 512-token prompts (p95 from 430ms -> 250ms)
- Per-token cost decreased ~28% after enabling prefix caching and moving to the q4_8 quant profile
- Throughput during peak batch windows increased 2.2x with minimal latency regression
- No data leakage incidents; audit logging preserved request IDs for full traceability

These results are exactly the type of outcome our marketing and sales teams use in short customer spotlights. Would StandupAI be open to two quick things?

1) A 10–15 minute call (we're flexible) for a concise customer quote about business impact to include in a one-paragraph case blurb.
2) A one-line approval we can publish: a short sentence (1–2 lines) capturing the top outcome (e.g., "Redwood reduced inference costs by N% while improving latency").

If you're up for a call, Marcus and I can join. Otherwise, a one-liner reply here would be perfect.

Thanks — appreciate all the collaboration here.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: standup_poc_kpi_snapshot.pdf (summary)
Attachment: demo-recording-20260924.mp4 (link)

"StandupAI reduced inference latency by ~40% and lowered per-token cost by ~28% during our POC with Redwood Inference."

If you want the call, put Marcus and Grace on — they were great partners during the POC.

—Alyssa
